description: Test options of the platformio.ini [env] section.

# Test options

Configure unit testing with `pio test`.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`test_framework`](./test-framework.md) | A unit testing framework |
| [`test_filter`](./test-filter.md) | Process tests where the name matches specified patterns |
| [`test_ignore`](./test-ignore.md) | Ignore tests where the name matches specified patterns |
| [`test_port`](./test-port.md) | A serial port to communicate with a target device |
| [`test_speed`](./test-speed.md) | A connection speed (baud rate) to communicate with a target device |
| [`test_build_src`](./test-build-src.md) | Build main source code in pair with a test code |
| [`test_testing_command`](./test-testing-command.md) | A custom testing command that runs test cases and returns results to the standard output |
